title: Item:Fragmented Treasure of Myth Drannor

[[File:Fragmented Treasure of Myth Drannor.png|thumb|right]]

'''Fragmented Treasure of Myth Drannor''' is an item available from [[Sterling the Strongbox]] as part of the [[Sterling's Remnant Rush]] event. The box allows you to choose one of a selection of [[Myth Drannor]] items (all of the pack's [[Rare Loot List|rare loot list items]] except the [[Weaponry of the Golden Age]] line.)
